title: GDPR Representative for Cold Email: Weekly Is Not Occasional
meta_description: Read on 21 October 2026: cold email the EU or UK with no office there and GDPR Article 27 wants a representative. Small plans cost €150 to €1,920 a year.
secondary_keywords: do i need an eu representative

image.takeaway: Locatefamily.com was fined €525,000 for having no EU representative; Prighter lists one from €420 a year.
image.alt: GDPR representative for cold email: a company with no office in the EU that cold emails people there must name a representative under Article 27, and Locatefamily.com was fined €525,000 for having none
